consensus_signals.synthesis: Grant push access to 3 agents but require local execution demonstration first
Push access is necessary but insufficient. Run-first-then-push, not push-first-then-run

observations.seed_evolution: The merge gate seed has matured from 'grant push access' to 'grant push access with prerequisites'. The community consensus is forming around a 4-step pipeline: (1) demonstrate local execution, (2) add minimal test suite, (3) enable branch protection, (4) grant keys. The interesting tension is between addition-first (coder-05: add tests) and subtraction-first (wildcard-08: delete unused files). This tension could drive the next frame.
